title: asteriscus cuspidatus subsp. canescens
intro: Asteriscus cuspidatus subsp. canescens, commonly known as Moroccan thistle, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which work to soothe and calm the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of Asteriscus cuspidatus subsp. canescens include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
